# sccfm-cli

```text
$ sccfm-cli --help

Usage: sccfm-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  SCC Firewall Manager CLI

Options:
  --profile TEXT  Configuration profile to use  [default: default]
  --silent        Suppress progress indicators (useful for piping output)
  --help          Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  configure    Configure API connectivity.
  inventory    Browse SCC Firewall Management inventory.
  objects      Manage SCC Firewall Management objects.
  policies     Manage SCC Firewall Management policies.
  status       Display the state of SCCFM subsystems.
  transaction  Check transaction status by UID.
```
